title: Sprint 1 Complete: Data and Broker Infrastructure

title: Configure Ollama Cloud Models
description: CEO provided Ollama endpoint (http://187.124.18.55:32768) with 8 models available. Verified connectivity. Updated model names in team config (qwen3.5:cloud, deepseek-v4-pro:cloud, kimi-k2.6:cloud).
agreement: CEO confirmed Ollama running as Docker container
risks: Cloud models may have latency (kimi-k2.6 1T params takes 90s+). Timeout set to 60s.
next_step: Implement agent Python modules with Ollama integration

title: Implement 5 Recommendation Agents
description: Implemented BaseRecommendationAgent with Ollama API integration, timeout handling, and error recovery. Created 5 specialized agents: Technical (Candles, kimi-k2.6:cloud), Fundamental (Ledger, deepseek-v4-pro:cloud), Sentiment (Pulse, qwen3.5:cloud), Risk (Shield, deepseek-v4-pro:cloud), Thesis (Compass, kimi-k2.6:cloud). Each has structured prompt and output parser.
agreement: Modular agent design supports independent testing and model swapping
risks: Ollama API timeouts on large models (kimi-k2.6). 60s timeout set. Agents fallback to ERROR on failure.
next_step: Run full test suite and commit

title: Sprint 2 Complete: Agent Recommendation Workflow
description: Sprint 2 complete. 5 recommendation agents implemented with AgentRunner pipeline. 35 tests passing (12 agent tests + 23 existing). Ollama models verified and mapped. Agents ready for market data input. Paper trading pipeline end-to-end structure complete.
risks: Ollama API latency on kimi-k2.6:cloud (1T params) may cause timeouts. DeepSeek and Qwen models respond in ~6s. Live agent runs require sufficient timeout.
next_step: Sprint 3: Implement strategy engine, backtest engine, and first strategy backtest
